provenance.clause: screening rules referencing NACE MR0175 / ASME VIII-1 UCS-66 topics
provenance.licence: Project-authored heuristic screening rules; not qualified metallurgical advice
provenance.checked_by: UNVERIFIED - engineering heuristics pending review by a materials engineer

rules.message: Chloride-bearing service at elevated temperature can cause chloride stress-corrosion cracking of austenitic stainless steels.
rules.rationale: Austenitic grades are susceptible to chloride SCC above roughly 60 degC; consider duplex, higher-Mo grades or a coating/inhibitor.

rules.message: Wet H2S service triggers sour-service requirements; hardness and material selection must comply with the sour-service standard.
rules.rationale: Sulfide stress cracking risk; confirm material hardness limits and qualification per NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156.

rules.message: Hydrofluoric acid service requires special material and post-weld heat-treatment review.
rules.rationale: HF causes severe corrosion and hydrogen damage; Monel or specialised alloys and PWHT are typically required.

rules.message: Hydrochloric acid service is aggressive to carbon and many stainless steels; review alloy selection and corrosion allowance.
rules.rationale: HCl attacks carbon steel and pitting/crevice corrosion is a risk for austenitic grades; non-metallic lining or higher alloys may be needed.

rules.message: Ammonia service attacks copper-based alloys (stress-corrosion cracking of brass/bronze).
rules.rationale: Ammonia complexes copper; copper alloys must be avoided in ammonia service.

rules.message: Caustic service can cause caustic stress-corrosion cracking of carbon steel; post-weld heat treatment and stress relief review required.
rules.rationale: Concentrated caustic at elevated temperature embrittles unrelieved carbon steel; PWHT reduces residual stress.

rules.message: Carbon steel below the minimum design metal temperature is a brittle-fracture risk; impact testing or a low-temperature material is required.
rules.rationale: The impact-test exemption curves limit carbon steel use at low temperature; select impact-tested or austenitic material.

rules.message: Water service can corrode carbon steel; corrosion allowance and/or water treatment must be specified.
rules.rationale: Wet carbon steel corrodes; without treatment or a corrosion allowance the design life is not met.
